cells.raw_text: Time points: 3M‐Pre (3 months prior to the procedure); 2D‐Pre (2 days prior to the procedure); 4M‐Post (4 months following the procedure); 1Y‐Post (1 year following the procedure). BMI, body mass index; FVC, forced vital capacity; FEV_(1), forced expiratory volume in 1 sec.
Time points: 3M‐Pre (3 months prior to the procedure);
FEV_(1), forced expiratory volume in 1 sec.

VO_(2max), maximal oxygen uptake; VCO_(2), maximal carbon dioxide production; RER, respiratory exchange ratio (VCO_(2)/VO_(2)); V_(E), minute ventilation; V_(E)/VO_(2), peak ventilatory equivalent ratio for oxygen; V_(E)/VCO_(2), ventilatory equivalent for carbon dioxide; HR_(max), maximal heart rate; GET, gas exchange threshold; SpO_(2), arterial oxygen saturation; RPE, rating of perceived effort; RPD, rating of perceived dyspnea. a HR_(max) only available for two tests due to equipment malfunction.
V_(E)/VO_(2), peak ventilatory equivalent ratio for oxygen;
V_(E)/VCO_(2), ventilatory equivalent for carbon dioxide;
a HR_(max) only available for two tests due to equipment malfunction.
